newsitem.title: INDIA: India's MMTC Ltd posts higher profits in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: India's MMTC Ltd posts higher profits in 1996/97.

text.p: India's state-run MMTC Ltd, one of the largest commodities trading agencies, said on Tuesday its net profit in 1996/97 (April-March) grew to to 551 million rupees ($15.4 million) from 502 million rupees in the previous year.

A MMTC statement said the company's profit, before the absorption of net loss of 397 million rupees of Mica Trading Corporation (MITCO), totalled 948 million rupees compared with 502 million rupees in 1994/95.
MITCO after it was declared a sick company was merged with MMTC by an order of the Board of Industrial and Financial Reconstruction (BIFR).

The statement said MMTC's turnover in 1996/97 dropped to 46.8 billion rupees from 62.2 billion in 1995/96, mainly due to lower imports of urea and sugar and discontinuation of an exporters' scheme for gold jewellery.
The company said during 1996/97 most of MMTC's turnover had come from either new products or from repositioning of old products in new markets.
